info.description: The Carrental Reservations Pricing API provides access to the dynamic pricing information for car rental reservations. Users can retrieve current pricing details based on various factors such as location, vehicle type, and rental duration. This API is essential for travel agencies and car rental companies looking to optimize pricing strategies and enhance customer experience. It simplifies the integration of pricing information into booking systems, ensuring that consumers have access to transparent and real-time pricing data.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the current pricing information for reservations. Use this to display pricing options to customers before they make a booking. Ensure you handle the pricing data accordingly to provide accurate and timely information during the reservation process.
